mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.role, u.center_id AS centerId, c.name AS centerName, u.name, u.email, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, u.status, u.token_version AS tokenVersion FROM users u JOIN centers c ON c.center_id=u.center_id WHERE u.email = LOWER(#{email}) AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.role, u.center_id AS centerId, c.name AS centerName, u.name, u.email, u.status, sp.student_id AS studentId FROM users u JOIN centers c ON c.center_id=u.center_id LEFT JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT student_id FROM student_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(role, center_id, name, email, password_hash, age, terms_agreed) VALUES(#{role}, #{centerId}, #{name}, LOWER(#{email}), #{passwordHash}, #{age}, #{termsAgreed})
INSERT INTO student_profiles(user_id, center_id, name, age) VALUES(#{userId}, #{centerId}, #{name}, #{age})
INSERT INTO refresh_tokens(user_id, token_hash, expires_at, session_id) VALUES(#{userId}, #{hash}, #{expiresAt}, #{sessionId})
mapper.select: SELECT r.user_id AS userId, u.role, u.token_version AS tokenVersion, r.session_id AS sessionId FROM refresh_tokens r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.token_hash = #{hash} AND r.revoked_at IS NULL AND r.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE token_hash = #{hash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT session_id FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{hash}
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM password_change_failures WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND)

SELECT GREATEST(1, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, DATE_ADD(MIN(created_at), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND))) FROM password_change_failures WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM refresh_tokens WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM refresh_tokens WHERE revoked_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{retentionSeconds} SECOND) LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM password_change_failures WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{olderThanSeconds} SECOND) LIMIT #{limit}
